qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (in_market = N, REJECT). Headquartered and listed in Poland, which falls outside the screener's approved Western developed market universe. Furthermore, discretionary e-commerce marketplace faces intense cross-border platform competition from Temu, Shein, and Amazon Poland, alongside past capital misallocation in the Mall Group acquisition.
qualitative.evidence: Allegro operates Poland's dominant online marketplace with >14 million active buyers and the Smart! loyalty subscription. However, Poland is excluded from the Western developed market list (in_market = N), triggering an automatic Gate 2 failure under screener rules. Economically, while domestic Polish GMV and EBITDA have been resilient, the cross-border acquisition of Mall Group resulted in a PLN 2.3B impairment in 2022, and long-term take-rates face persistent pricing pressure from Chinese cross-border discount platforms (Temu, Shein) and Amazon.
